morning.situation: It's Monday morning
morning.line: Did you do anything fun this weekend?

morning.situation: There's a new kid
A kid is wearing a team or character shirt
A group is already talking
morning.tip: Listen for about 10 seconds first, then jump in.

morning.situation: You see a kid you know walking in
morning.tip: A wave and a smile count too.

morning.situation: Someone has new shoes, a haircut, or a new backpack
morning.line: Ooh, is that new? It looks cool.

morning.situation: Someone looks really tired
morning.followUp: Same. I could barely get up.

morning.situation: You're waiting in line to go in
morning.line: Did you watch anything good last night?

morning.situation: A kid was out sick yesterday
It's the first day back after a break
A kid sits down next to you before class starts
Someone says "hi" to you first
A kid looks excited about something
It's raining or really cold
morning.line: Ugh, this weather! Did you walk?

morning.situation: Someone has a cool water bottle or lunchbox
morning.line: Where'd you get that? I like it.

morning.situation: A kid is carrying a project or poster
There's a field trip or special event today
morning.followUp: What do you think it'll be like?

morning.situation: A kid you know is walking in alone
morning.tip: Catching up to someone is an easy way in.

morning.situation: Someone mentions their birthday is coming
morning.line: Happy early birthday! Are you doing anything?

morning.situation: A kid drops something on the way in
Someone asks how you are
morning.tip: Always add the "You?" It hands the turn back.

morning.situation: You forgot to bring something for class
morning.line: Oh no, I forgot my ___. Did you remember yours?

morning.situation: A kid has a book you've read
morning.line: I read that one! Where are you at?
morning.followUp: No spoilers, but the ending is good.

morning.situation: There's a substitute teacher today
morning.line: Do you know who the sub is?

morning.situation: Someone is humming or singing a song you know
morning.line: Is that ___? I love that song.

morning.situation: A kid looks like they're having a bad morning
morning.line: You okay? Want to walk in together?

morning.situation: It's the first day of school
morning.line: Hi, I'm ___. Who do you have this year?

morning.situation: A kid says they have a game or recital tonight
morning.line: Cool! Are you nervous or excited?

morning.situation: You notice someone did their hair a new way
morning.line: I like your hair like that.

morning.situation: Kids are talking about a video or meme
morning.line: Wait, I haven't seen it. What happens in it?

morning.situation: Someone yawns really big
You both got to school super early

class.situation: A kid you sort of know sits near you
class.line: Hey, did you do the math homework?

class.situation: Someone is drawing or reading
class.line: What's that about?

class.situation: The teacher says to find a partner
class.line: Want to be partners?
class.tip: Pick someone who's still looking. They're hoping someone asks.

class.situation: You're stuck on a question
class.line: How did you get number 4?
class.tip: Ask during partner or group work, not on a quiz or test.

class.situation: You need a pencil or an eraser
class.line: Can I borrow a pencil? I'll give it back.

class.situation: Someone near you needs something you have
class.line: Here, you can use mine.

class.situation: You're in a group project and have an idea
class.line: What if we tried ___?

class.situation: Someone gives a great answer or presentation
class.line: That was really good. How did you think of that?

class.situation: Class just finished a test
class.line: How do you think you did?
class.followUp: That last one was so hard.

class.situation: Your group is quiet and nobody's starting
class.line: Should we split up the jobs?
class.tip: Offer to take one job first. It gets everyone going.

class.situation: The teacher tells everyone to get into groups
class.line: Can I be in your group?

class.situation: You finished early and the kid next to you did too
class.line: Done? What are you gonna do now?

class.situation: Someone is stuck on a question you got
class.line: Want me to show you how I did that one?

class.situation: You didn't hear the directions
class.line: What page did she say?
class.tip: Asking the kid next to you is normal. Everyone does it.

class.situation: You need to share a book or laptop
class.line: Want to share? I can hold it in the middle.

class.situation: Someone forgot their supplies
class.line: You can use some of mine.

class.situation: You both drew the same thing in art
class.line: Ha, we did the same one! Let me see yours.

class.situation: Your group is picking who presents
class.line: I can go first if nobody wants to.
class.tip: Volunteering for the small stuff makes you the brave one.

class.situation: You disagree with your group's plan
class.line: What if we did it this way instead?

class.situation: A kid says something funny in class
class.line: That was funny.
class.tip: Say it to them after, not during the lesson.

class.situation: Someone gets a good grade back
class.line: Nice job! What'd you get?

class.situation: You get a bad grade back and the kid next to you sees
class.line: Ugh. That one was rough.

class.situation: The teacher assigns a reading partner
class.line: Want to take turns reading a page each?

class.situation: You're passing back papers
class.line: Here's yours.
class.tip: Say their name when you hand it over.

class.situation: Someone asks what the homework is
class.line: It's page 12, I think. Want to check with me?

class.situation: You're in a science lab group
class.line: I'll write it down if you do the measuring.

class.situation: A kid is nervous before presenting
class.line: You got this. It's gonna be good.

class.situation: Your group finished and has extra time
class.line: Want to play a quick game of hangman?

class.situation: Someone sneezes
class.line: Bless you.
class.tip: Tiny things like this count. They make people notice you in a good way.

class.situation: The teacher lets you pick your own seat
class.line: Is anyone sitting here?

class.situation: The teacher asks a question and nobody answers
class.line: I think it's ___?
class.tip: Even a wrong guess is brave. Teachers love it.

class.situation: You want to switch jobs in your group
class.line: Can we trade? I'll do the poster and you do the writing.

class.situation: Someone helped you with a problem
class.line: Thanks, that helped a lot.

class.situation: You're working on a computer and it freezes
class.line: Yours doing this too?

class.situation: A new kid joins your class
class.line: I'm ___. If you need help finding stuff, just ask me.

recess.situation: A group is playing a game
recess.line: Can I play next round?

recess.situation: You want to join a game that already started
recess.line: That looks fun. Can I be on a team?
recess.tip: Stand close and watch for a minute first so you know the game.

recess.situation: A kid is by themselves at recess
recess.line: Want to play ___ with me?

recess.situation: Some kids' ball rolls over to you
recess.line: Here you go!

recess.situation: You want to start a game
recess.line: Who wants to play tag?
recess.tip: Ask a few kids at once. It makes it easy to say yes.

recess.situation: Kids are arguing about the rules
recess.line: Let's just redo that one.
recess.tip: A redo is fair and gets the game going again.

recess.situation: Someone makes a great play
recess.line: Nice one! How did you do that?

recess.situation: Your team loses
recess.line: Good game. Rematch tomorrow?

recess.situation: You want to take a break from the game
recess.line: I'm gonna take a break. Save my spot?

recess.situation: You want to play on the swings but they're full
recess.line: Can I have a turn when you're done?

recess.situation: Someone asks if you want to play
recess.line: Sure! What are we playing?

recess.situation: You'd rather play something else
recess.line: Can we play ___ after this?

recess.situation: Kids are picking teams
recess.line: Can I be on your team?

recess.situation: Someone gets hurt during a game
recess.line: Are you okay? Want me to get a teacher?

recess.situation: You accidentally hit someone with the ball
recess.line: Sorry! Are you okay?

recess.situation: You're the new kid at recess
recess.line: What games do you guys usually play?

recess.situation: A kid is reading alone on a bench
recess.line: What are you reading?

recess.situation: Kids are doing handstands or cartwheels
recess.line: Can you show me how to do that?

recess.situation: Someone is bad at the game and getting frustrated
recess.line: It's okay, it took me forever to learn too.

recess.situation: The game is getting boring
recess.line: Want to make up a new rule?

recess.situation: Someone is sitting out because they got out
recess.line: You can be on my team next round.

recess.situation: You want to trade jobs in the game
recess.line: Can I be the tagger this time?

recess.situation: A ball goes over the fence
recess.line: I'll go tell a teacher.

recess.situation: Your friend is playing with someone else
recess.line: Can I play too?
recess.tip: Two friends is not a closed club. Just ask.

recess.situation: Someone is drawing with chalk
recess.line: Can I add to your drawing?

recess.situation: Recess is almost over
recess.line: One more round?

recess.situation: Two kids want you to choose which game to play
recess.line: Let's do rock-paper-scissors for it.
recess.tip: You don't have to pick. Give them a fair way to decide.

recess.situation: You won the game
recess.line: Good game, guys!
recess.tip: Say it to the other team too.

recess.situation: A kid is doing something cool with a jump rope
recess.line: How many can you do in a row?

recess.situation: You want to sit and talk instead of run around
recess.line: Want to just sit and hang out today?

recess.situation: A little kid needs help
recess.line: Do you need help? I can get a teacher.

lunch.situation: A kid is sitting alone at lunch
lunch.line: Can I sit here?

lunch.situation: They like something you like
lunch.line: Same. Which one's your favorite?

lunch.situation: They're telling you a story
lunch.line: No way. What happened next?

lunch.situation: You don't know what to say
lunch.line: Repeat their last word as a question, like "Minecraft?"
lunch.tip: They'll usually keep talking. Works with almost any word.

lunch.situation: Lunch is ending
lunch.line: What are you doing at recess?

lunch.situation: Someone has a food you've never seen
lunch.line: What's that? Is it good?

lunch.situation: They talk about a show or game you don't know
lunch.line: What's it about? Should I try it?

lunch.situation: It's Friday
lunch.line: Doing anything fun this weekend?

lunch.situation: Your usual seat is taken
lunch.line: Mind if I squeeze in here?

lunch.situation: Everyone at the table is quiet
lunch.line: Random question: would you rather fly or be invisible?
lunch.tip: A would-you-rather question gets everyone talking.

lunch.situation: Someone asks to sit with you
lunch.line: Yeah, sit here!
lunch.tip: Move your stuff over so it's obvious.

lunch.situation: You want to trade snacks
lunch.line: Want to trade? I have ___.

lunch.situation: Someone spills their drink
lunch.line: Oh no! Here, I have napkins.

lunch.situation: A kid is eating something that smells amazing
lunch.line: That smells so good. What is it?

lunch.situation: You sit down at a table and nobody says anything
lunch.line: Hey guys. What's up?

lunch.situation: Someone asks what you brought
lunch.line: Just a sandwich. What about you?

lunch.situation: Kids are talking about a movie you saw
lunch.line: I saw that! The part with the ___ was the best.

lunch.situation: Kids are talking about a movie you didn't see
lunch.line: Is it good? Should I watch it?

lunch.situation: Someone tells you they're having a bad day
lunch.line: That sounds rough. Want to sit by me?

lunch.situation: You want to ask about their weekend plans
lunch.line: Doing anything this weekend?

lunch.situation: Someone tells a joke
lunch.line: Ha! Okay, do you know the one about ___?

lunch.situation: You have extra snacks
lunch.line: Anyone want some? I have extra.
lunch.tip: Ask about allergies first. Sharing gets people talking.

lunch.situation: You need to get up and don't want to lose your seat
lunch.line: Can you save my seat? I'll be right back.

lunch.situation: Someone new joins the table
lunch.line: Hi, I'm ___.
lunch.tip: Just your name. That's all it takes.

lunch.situation: The table is talking about pets
lunch.line: Do you have any pets?

lunch.situation: The table is talking about sports
lunch.line: Do you play anything?

lunch.situation: You want to start a game at the table
lunch.line: Want to play 20 questions?

lunch.situation: Someone is telling a really long story
lunch.line: Wait, go back. Who said that?
lunch.tip: Asking a question shows you're listening.

lunch.situation: A kid drops their tray
lunch.line: Here, I'll help.

lunch.situation: Someone asks if you've been somewhere
lunch.line: No, is it fun? What's it like?

lunch.situation: You want to ask about their favorite stuff
lunch.line: What's your favorite show right now?

lunch.situation: Someone says they're bored
lunch.line: Same. Want to make up a game?

lunch.situation: The table is arguing about which is better
lunch.line: I like both, honestly.
lunch.tip: You don't have to pick a side.

lunch.situation: It's someone's birthday
lunch.line: Happy birthday! Doing anything fun?

lunch.situation: You're leaving the lunch table
lunch.line: I'm gonna head out. See you at recess.

after-school.situation: They mention a hobby
after-school.line: Oh cool, how'd you get into that?

after-school.situation: You're at a club or practice and don't know anyone
after-school.line: Is this your first time here too?

after-school.situation: You're waiting for pickup next to a kid
after-school.line: What are you doing after this?

after-school.situation: A teammate does something great at practice
after-school.line: Nice! Can you show me how you did that?

after-school.situation: You want to hang out outside of school
after-school.line: Want to hang out this weekend? I can ask my parents.
after-school.tip: Then a grown-up can text their grown-up.

after-school.situation: A kid from school lives near you
after-school.line: You live here too? Want to ride bikes sometime?

after-school.situation: You didn't understand what the coach said
after-school.line: Sorry, can you show me that again?

after-school.situation: You're in a carpool with a kid
after-school.line: What was the best part of your day?

after-school.situation: A kid plays the same video game as you
after-school.line: What level are you on?

after-school.situation: You're at a birthday party and don't know many kids
after-school.line: How do you know ___?

after-school.situation: You're at a sleepover and it's getting quiet
after-school.line: Want to watch something?

after-school.situation: A kid at practice is good at something
after-school.line: You're really good. How long have you been playing?

after-school.situation: You're at the park and see a kid your age
after-school.line: Hi. Want to play?

after-school.situation: A kid at the library is reading your favorite series
after-school.line: That series is so good. Which book are you on?

after-school.situation: You're at a playdate and don't know what to do
after-school.line: What do you want to do? I'm fine with anything.

after-school.situation: Your friend brings another friend you don't know
after-school.line: Hi, I'm ___. What do you guys usually play?

after-school.situation: The coach puts you with a new partner
after-school.line: Hey, I'm ___. Want to go first?

after-school.situation: A kid on your team makes a mistake
after-school.line: It's okay, we got the next one.

after-school.situation: Your team wins
after-school.line: Yes! Good job, guys!

after-school.situation: You want to invite someone over
after-school.line: Want to come over sometime? My mom can text your mom.

after-school.situation: Someone invites you over
after-school.line: Yeah! Let me ask my parents.

after-school.situation: You're at a friend's house and want a snack
after-school.line: Can I have a snack?
after-school.tip: It's okay to ask. It's not rude.

after-school.situation: You want to go home from a playdate
after-school.line: I think I'm gonna head home soon. This was fun.
after-school.tip: Then ask their grown-up to call your mom or dad.

after-school.situation: A kid at practice is sitting alone
after-school.line: Want to stretch together?

after-school.situation: You see a classmate at the grocery store
after-school.line: Hey! Weird seeing you here.

after-school.situation: You want to join a game at the park
after-school.line: Can I play?

after-school.situation: You're at a class like art or coding and don't know anyone
after-school.line: What are you making?

after-school.situation: A kid says they have a pet
after-school.line: What kind? What's its name?

after-school.situation: You're waiting at the dentist or doctor next to a kid
after-school.line: Do you go to school around here?

after-school.situation: A kid you know is at your sibling's game
after-school.line: Oh hey! Who are you here to watch?

after-school.situation: You want to text a friend after school
after-school.line: Hey, what's up? Want to play later?

after-school.situation: You want to plan a bike ride
after-school.line: Want to ride bikes Saturday?

goodbye.line: Okay, I'm gonna go grab my stuff. See you.
I gotta go, bye.

goodbye.situation: You want to see them again
goodbye.line: Want to sit together tomorrow?
See you tomorrow!
Have a good weekend!
That was fun. Let's do it again.

goodbye.situation: They told you about something coming up
goodbye.line: Good luck with your ___!
goodbye.tip: Remembering what they told you makes them feel noticed.

goodbye.situation: You have to leave in the middle of their story
goodbye.line: I have to go, but tell me the rest tomorrow!
Thanks for having me!
goodbye.tip: Say it to the grown-up too.

goodbye.line: Happy birthday! Thanks for inviting me.
See you! Bye!

goodbye.situation: The car is here to pick you up
goodbye.line: That's my ride. See you tomorrow!

goodbye.situation: It's the last day before a break
goodbye.line: Have a good break! See you after.

goodbye.situation: You want to make plans for next time
goodbye.line: Want to play again next week?
Good practice. See you next time!

goodbye.situation: You're hanging up a video call
goodbye.line: Okay, I gotta go. Bye!
I'll miss you. Can we still text?

goodbye.situation: You're saying bye to a kid you just met
goodbye.line: It was nice meeting you.

goodbye.situation: You have to leave a game early
goodbye.line: I have to go. Thanks for letting me play!
Bye! See you later!
goodbye.tip: Say their name too if you know it.

goodbye.line: Have a great summer!

goodbye.situation: You lost the game and it's time to go
goodbye.line: Good game. You got me this time.

goodbye.situation: You want to end a conversation that's dragging
goodbye.line: Anyway, I should go. See you around.

brain-freeze.situation: Your mind goes blank
brain-freeze.line: Ask a question about anything they just said.

brain-freeze.situation: Your mind goes blank
brain-freeze.tip: Shoes, backpack, drawing, anything. One real thing.

brain-freeze.situation: Your mind goes blank
brain-freeze.line: Hm, I forgot what I was gonna say.
brain-freeze.tip: Then smile. It happens to everyone.

brain-freeze.situation: They asked you something and you answered
brain-freeze.tip: Bounce the question back. It works almost every time.

brain-freeze.situation: There is a long, quiet pause
brain-freeze.line: So what's your favorite thing to do?

brain-freeze.situation: You didn't hear what they said
They talk about something you don't know
brain-freeze.line: I don't know that one. What is it?
brain-freeze.tip: Not knowing is fine. People like explaining.

brain-freeze.situation: Your heart is pounding
brain-freeze.line: Take one slow breath, then just say "Hey."

brain-freeze.situation: You can't think of anything to say
brain-freeze.tip: Boring is fine. It fills the gap.

brain-freeze.situation: Someone asks what you like to do
You blanked on what they said
You realize you've been quiet a long time
brain-freeze.line: Sorry, I was thinking. What were we talking about?

brain-freeze.situation: You want to leave but don't know how
brain-freeze.line: Okay, I'm gonna go. See you later!

brain-freeze.situation: Someone asks a question you don't want to answer
brain-freeze.line: I'd rather not say. Hey, did you see ___?

brain-freeze.situation: You don't know if they're joking
You feel like everyone is looking at you
brain-freeze.line: Look at one friendly face, take a breath, and say one word.
brain-freeze.tip: Nobody is watching as closely as it feels.

brain-freeze.situation: You need a question fast
brain-freeze.tip: Food, game, show, animal. Pick any one.

brain-freeze.situation: Someone laughs and you don't get it
You got asked something and just froze
brain-freeze.line: Um, let me think. Ask me again?

brain-freeze.situation: Your voice comes out too quiet
brain-freeze.line: Say it again, a little louder.
brain-freeze.tip: Being asked to repeat yourself is not a big deal.

brain-freeze.situation: You forgot what game they said
You don't know their name
brain-freeze.tip: Later you can ask, "Sorry, what's your name again?" Everyone forgets names.

brain-freeze.situation: You need an easy way to start
The conversation just ended and it feels awkward
brain-freeze.tip: Ending it is better than standing there.

brain-freeze.situation: You want to agree but can't think of words
You need to fill a pause
brain-freeze.line: So anyway, what were you saying?

tricky.situation: You asked to join and they said no
tricky.line: Okay, maybe next time.
tricky.tip: Then go find someone else. It's not about you.

tricky.situation: You interrupted someone by accident
tricky.line: Oops, sorry. Go ahead.

tricky.situation: Your joke didn't land
tricky.line: Okay, that one was bad.
tricky.tip: Laughing at yourself makes it no big deal.

tricky.situation: You don't agree with someone
tricky.line: I kind of think ___, but that's cool.

tricky.situation: Kids are making plans in front of you
tricky.line: That sounds fun. Can I come too?

tricky.situation: Someone looks upset
tricky.line: Are you okay?

tricky.situation: You said something that hurt someone's feelings
tricky.line: Sorry, I didn't mean it like that.

tricky.situation: Someone teases you
tricky.line: Okay. Anyway...
tricky.tip: A calm, bored answer takes the fun out of it. If it keeps happening, tell a grown-up.

tricky.situation: You forgot someone's name
tricky.line: Sorry, I forgot your name. What is it again?

tricky.situation: You tripped or dropped all your stuff
tricky.line: Ha. Smooth, right?
tricky.tip: Smile and keep going. Everyone forgets about it fast.

tricky.situation: A kid ignores you when you say hi
tricky.line: Say hi again later, or say it to someone else.
tricky.tip: They might not have heard. Try once more, then move on.

tricky.situation: You lose a game and feel mad
tricky.line: Good game. I'm gonna take a minute.
tricky.tip: Walking away for a minute is allowed.

tricky.situation: Someone says something mean about your friend
tricky.line: That's not cool. She's my friend.

tricky.situation: You broke something at a friend's house
tricky.line: I'm really sorry, I broke this. I didn't mean to.
tricky.tip: Telling right away is always better than hiding it.

tricky.situation: Two friends are fighting and want you to pick
tricky.line: I like both of you. I'm not picking.

tricky.situation: A friend didn't invite you to their party
tricky.line: I heard about your party. Did it go okay?
tricky.tip: You can ask without being mad. Sometimes it's not about you.

tricky.situation: You got a worse grade than your friend
tricky.line: Nice job. I'm gonna study more next time.

tricky.situation: Someone asks a question that's too personal
tricky.line: I don't really want to talk about that.

tricky.situation: You said something wrong and everyone laughed
tricky.line: Ha, oops. Anyway.

tricky.situation: You want to say no to a friend nicely
tricky.line: I can't today, but maybe another time.

tricky.situation: Someone is bragging a lot
tricky.line: That's cool. Hey, did you ___?

tricky.situation: A friend is mad at you and you don't know why
tricky.line: Are you mad at me? Did I do something?

tricky.situation: You need to tell a friend they did something that bugged you
tricky.line: Hey, when you ___, it kind of bugged me.
tricky.tip: Say it once, calmly. Then let it go.

tricky.situation: Someone keeps talking and you can't get a word in
tricky.line: Wait, can I say something?

tricky.situation: A kid is crying
tricky.line: Do you want me to get a teacher?
tricky.tip: You don't have to fix it. Just help them get help.

tricky.situation: You accidentally left someone out
tricky.line: Sorry, I didn't mean to leave you out. Come play.

tricky.situation: You don't like the game everyone wants to play
tricky.line: I'll play a couple rounds, then can we switch?

tricky.situation: Someone gave you a gift you don't like
tricky.line: Thank you! That was nice of you.
tricky.tip: You're thanking them for thinking of you.

tricky.situation: Someone is whispering and you think it's about you
tricky.line: Ask a friend to play something. Move away from it.
tricky.tip: If it keeps happening, tell a grown-up.

tricky.situation: A friend copied your idea
tricky.line: Ha, we think alike. Want to do it together?

tricky.situation: You feel left out at a party
tricky.line: Find the food table or a game and stand by it.
tricky.tip: Kids come to you. Then just say hi.

tricky.situation: A grown-up you don't know asks you a question
tricky.line: Answer short and polite. It's okay to say "I don't know."
tricky.tip: You never have to say where you live or go anywhere with them. If it feels weird, find a grown-up you know.

tricky.situation: Someone says your drawing or work is bad
tricky.line: I like it. Everyone has their own style.

tricky.situation: You need to apologize for being grumpy
tricky.line: Sorry I was grumpy earlier. I wasn't mad at you.

stand-up.situation: Someone is playing too rough
stand-up.line: I don't like the way you're playing. Stop.
stand-up.tip: Say it loud, stand tall, and look at them.

stand-up.situation: Kids want you to do something you don't want to do
stand-up.line: I don't want to do that.
stand-up.tip: You don't need a reason. No is enough.

stand-up.situation: Someone keeps changing the rules so they win
stand-up.line: That's not fair. We already said the rules.

stand-up.situation: Someone grabs something of yours
stand-up.line: Hey, that's mine. Give it back, please.

stand-up.situation: Someone cuts in front of you in line
stand-up.line: Hey, I was here first.

stand-up.situation: Kids are laughing at a joke about you
stand-up.line: That's not funny to me. Stop.

stand-up.situation: A kid says you can't play, for no reason
stand-up.line: Everybody's allowed to play.
stand-up.tip: If they still won't let you, find a better game and tell a grown-up.

stand-up.situation: One kid always decides everything
stand-up.line: It's my turn to pick.

stand-up.situation: Someone keeps poking or touching you
stand-up.line: Don't touch me. I mean it.

stand-up.situation: Someone calls you a name
stand-up.line: That's not my name. Don't call me that.

stand-up.situation: People keep talking over you
stand-up.line: Wait, I wasn't done.

stand-up.situation: Someone keeps copying your work
stand-up.line: Please stop copying my paper.

stand-up.situation: You said yes, but now you want to say no
stand-up.line: Actually, I changed my mind. I don't want to.
stand-up.tip: You're allowed to change your mind.

stand-up.situation: Someone is being mean to another kid
stand-up.line: Hey, cut it out. That's not cool.
stand-up.tip: Standing next to the kid who got picked on helps too.

stand-up.situation: Someone says "Do it or you're not my friend"
stand-up.line: Real friends don't say that. I'm not doing it.

stand-up.situation: You said stop and they didn't
stand-up.line: I said stop. I'm getting a grown-up.
stand-up.tip: Getting help is brave. It is not tattling.

stand-up.situation: Someone won't let you have a turn
stand-up.line: It's my turn now. You already went.

stand-up.situation: A kid takes your seat
stand-up.line: Hey, I was sitting there. Can I have it back?

stand-up.situation: Someone pushes you in line
stand-up.line: Don't push me.
stand-up.tip: Firm and calm. You don't have to yell.

stand-up.situation: A kid tells you to lie to a teacher
stand-up.line: No. I'm not lying for you.

stand-up.situation: Someone keeps making fun of what you're eating
stand-up.line: I like it. You don't have to.

stand-up.situation: A kid dares you to do something dangerous
stand-up.line: Nope. I'm not doing that.
stand-up.tip: A dare is not a rule. You can just say no.

stand-up.situation: Someone says girls can't play
stand-up.line: Yes we can. I'm playing.

stand-up.situation: Someone won't stop tickling or hugging you
stand-up.line: Stop. I don't like that.
stand-up.tip: Your body is yours. You get to say stop. If they don't stop, tell a grown-up you trust.

stand-up.situation: A friend keeps telling your secrets
stand-up.line: I told you that in private. Please don't share it.

stand-up.situation: Someone is spreading a rumor about you
stand-up.line: That's not true, and I don't like it.
stand-up.tip: Say it once, then tell a grown-up.

stand-up.situation: Kids say you have to do something to sit with them
stand-up.line: I don't need to do that to sit here.

stand-up.situation: A kid says your friend is weird
stand-up.line: I like her. She's my friend.

stand-up.situation: Someone messes up your work on purpose
stand-up.line: Stop it. I worked hard on that.

stand-up.situation: Someone keeps interrupting you
stand-up.line: Let me finish, please.

stand-up.situation: A kid says you're bad at something
stand-up.line: I'm still learning. That's fine.

stand-up.situation: Someone tells you to give them your snack
stand-up.line: No, that's mine.

stand-up.situation: Someone says "just kidding" after being mean
stand-up.line: It didn't feel like kidding. Don't say that.

stand-up.situation: A kid takes your ball or toy without asking
stand-up.line: Ask first next time. Can I have it back?

stand-up.situation: Someone says you can't sit with them
stand-up.line: Okay. I'll sit somewhere else.
stand-up.tip: Say it like you don't care. Then go sit with someone who's glad to have you.

stand-up.situation: Someone is being mean online or in a group chat
stand-up.line: That's mean. I'm leaving the chat.
stand-up.tip: Screenshot it first, then leave and show a grown-up.

stand-up.situation: Someone says you have to keep a secret that feels wrong
stand-up.line: I don't keep secrets like that.
stand-up.tip: Tell a grown-up you trust right away, even if they said not to.

stand-up.situation: A kid pressures you to share your password
stand-up.line: No. I don't share that with anyone.

stand-up.situation: Somebody cheated in the game
stand-up.line: Hey, I don't think that counts. Can we redo it?
